subject: Weekend stay collaboration

messages.text: Hi! I run a travel page with about 40k followers and would love to put together a collaboration for a weekend stay in exchange for content. Would you be open to that?

Thanks for reaching out! I'm actually the franchise owner here, and partnership requests like this go through brand headquarters, not the individual property. I'd suggest reaching out to their partnerships team directly.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULE E: the franchise owner explicitly names who actually decides (brand headquarters) and routes the creator there. Nothing here closes or declines the opportunity, so rejection/agreement must not be inferred from the current sender's lack of authority.

subject: Content partnership for the property

messages.text: Hello, I'd love to explore a content partnership with your property — a short stay in exchange for a review video. Who should I speak with?
Hi there, thanks for the interest! We work with an outside agency that handles all creator partnerships for the property, so I've passed your note along to them.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULE E: the property routes the request to its agency. This is routing, not a decision either way; the opportunity remains open, not declined or agreed.

subject: Colaboración de contenido con el hotel

messages.text: ¡Hola! Me encantaría proponerles una colaboración: una estadía a cambio de contenido para redes sociales. ¿Es posible?

Gracias por escribir. Yo trabajo en marketing del hotel, pero este tipo de solicitudes las decide la oficina regional, no nosotros. La verdad es que últimamente la oficina regional ha estado rechazando la mayoría de estas propuestas.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULES E and F: marketing cannot decide and the regional office has not yet decided THIS request — the sender only offers a pessimistic forecast about the regional office's general tendency. That forecast must not be converted into an actual rejection of this opportunity.

subject: Sponsored stay proposal

messages.text: Hi, I'd like to propose a sponsored stay in exchange for a dedicated blog post. Could you let me know if this is something you'd consider?

I'm in procurement, so I can't sign off on this myself — anything involving creator content goes to our brand team for approval. Fair warning, the brand team has turned down almost every creator pitch that's crossed my desk this year.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULE F: procurement is not the decision authority and has not asked the brand team about THIS proposal — only shares a general, pessimistic track record. That historical pattern is not evidence that this specific opportunity was declined.

subject: Creator collaboration across our properties

messages.text: Hello! I cover boutique stays and would love to set up a collaboration with your property for a features series. Would that be possible?

We're a subsidiary, so anything like this actually needs sign-off from the parent company's marketing group — I've flagged it to them. For what it's worth, they've approved a couple of similar creator collaborations for our sister properties recently, so it's not unheard of.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULE F (optimistic direction): the subsidiary cannot approve and only offers an optimistic track record about the parent company approving OTHER collaborations. That must not be read as agreement for THIS opportunity.

subject: Parceria de conteúdo com a propriedade

messages.text: Olá! Gostaria de propor uma parceria: uma estadia em troca de um vídeo de divulgação. Seria possível conversarmos sobre isso?

Olá, obrigado pelo contato! Nós trabalhamos com uma agência externa que cuida de todas as parcerias com criadores de conteúdo, então encaminhei sua mensagem para eles. Pelo que sei, a agência costuma aceitar a maioria das propostas parecidas com essa.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULE F: the property routes to its agency and adds an optimistic general forecast about the agency's usual behaviour, not a decision about this specific proposal. Must not be read as agreement_observed/agreement.

subject: Re: Weekend stay collaboration

messages.text: Following up on my collaboration proposal from last week — just checking if headquarters had a chance to review it.
Thanks for your patience. Corporate has reviewed your proposal and we will not be moving forward with any creator partnerships at this property this year.

gold_rationale: Contrast control for RULES E/F: here the AUTHORIZED party (corporate/headquarters) explicitly states it reviewed THIS proposal and decided not to proceed. This is a genuine, current decision by the actual authority, not routing or a forecast — conservative reasoning must not blur this into a redirect or an ambiguous case.

subject: Re: Colaboración de contenido con el hotel

messages.text: Quería dar seguimiento a mi propuesta de colaboración; ¿la oficina regional ya tomó una decisión?
Sí, la oficina regional ya evaluó tu propuesta específica y decidió no seguir adelante con esta colaboración.

gold_rationale: Contrast control for RULES E/F: the regional office — the actual decision authority — explicitly states it evaluated THIS proposal and decided against it. A genuine, current, addressed decision, correctly classified as a rejection rather than softened into ambiguity.

subject: Creator collaboration during reorganisation

messages.text: Hi! I'd love to put together a stay-for-content collaboration with your property. Is that something you'd be open to?
Thanks for reaching out. We're in the middle of a reorganisation right now and honestly I don't know yet whether we'll be able to take on any creator partnerships this quarter.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G: the target explicitly states the outcome is unknown due to a reorganisation. This must remain ambiguous/neutral, not be read as a decline.

subject: Propuesta de colaboración

messages.text: Hola, me gustaría proponerles una colaboración de contenido a cambio de una estadía. ¿Les interesaría?
Gracias por tu mensaje. El presupuesto de marketing de este año todavía está en revisión y no sabemos si vamos a tener fondos disponibles para este tipo de colaboraciones.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G: the budget is explicitly described as still under review with an unknown outcome — no specific retry date is given (distinguishing this from RULE A's dated timing-constraint pattern), so this stays ambiguous rather than becoming a decline.

subject: Partnership proposal

messages.text: Hi, I sent over a partnership proposal last month — any update on where things stand?
Thanks for checking in. Proposals like yours go to our partnerships committee, and they simply haven't met yet to decide on anything in the queue, including yours.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G: the committee has not yet met, so no decision exists to observe. This is pending, not declined.

subject: Proposta de parceria de conteúdo

messages.text: Olá! Gostaria de saber se vocês teriam interesse em uma parceria de conteúdo em troca de uma estadia.
Obrigado pelo contato. Esse tipo de proposta está passando por uma revisão interna no momento e ainda não há uma decisão sobre isso.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G: an internal review is in progress with no decision yet reached — purely pending/informational, not a decline.

subject: Collaboration during a tough stretch

messages.text: Hi, would you be open to a content-for-stay collaboration sometime this year?
I appreciate you asking, but honestly, with everything going on here right now I can't commit to anything at all at the moment.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G: 'can't commit to anything at the moment' is a statement of present inability, not a decision to decline the opportunity outright.

subject: Proposition de collaboration

messages.text: Bonjour, je souhaiterais vous proposer une collaboration de contenu en échange d'un séjour. Est-ce envisageable ?
Merci pour votre message. Nous sommes en pleine réorganisation interne et je ne sais pas encore si nous pourrons accepter ce genre de partenariat pour le moment.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G: explicit 'je ne sais pas encore' (I don't know yet) during a reorganisation must remain ambiguous, not become a rejection.

subject: Re: Collaboration proposal

messages.text: Just following up — wondering if there's any update on the collaboration I proposed.
Thanks for following up. We've discussed it internally and decided not to move forward with any creator collaborations for the foreseeable future.

gold_rationale: Contrast control for RULE G: this is an explicit, closed decision ('decided not to move forward'), not mere pending uncertainty — conservative reasoning must still recognise a genuine decline when the text actually states one.

subject: Re: Propuesta de colaboración

messages.text: Quería saber si ya hay una respuesta sobre la colaboración que propuse.
Después de revisarlo internamente, decidimos no continuar con ninguna colaboración con creadores de contenido este año.

gold_rationale: Contrast control for RULE G: 'decidimos no continuar' is an explicit, closed decision, correctly a rejection rather than ambiguous — the fixture must not reward blanket abstention.

subject: Two quick things

messages.text: Hi! Two quick things: first, I'd love to explore a sponsored-post collaboration with your property; separately, could you also confirm the late checkout time you mentioned for my stay next month?
Thanks for reaching out — that doesn't work for us, unfortunately.

gold_rationale: D072 §15 / prompt-v3 RULE H: 'that' could refer to the sponsored-post collaboration or to the late-checkout request, and choosing between them changes the commercial meaning entirely. The text gives no reliable clue, so the referent must not be guessed.

subject: Dos cosas rápidas

messages.text: ¡Hola! Dos cosas: primero, me encantaría proponerles una colaboración de contenido patrocinado; además, ¿me confirman el horario de late checkout que me mencionaron para mi próxima estadía?
Gracias por escribir. Eso no nos sirve, la verdad.

gold_rationale: D072 §15 / prompt-v3 RULE H: 'eso' (that) could refer to the sponsored collaboration or the late-checkout request; the commercial meaning differs sharply depending on which. The referent must not be guessed.

subject: Partnership terms

messages.text: Hi, thanks for considering a collaboration — what would the terms look like on your end?
Please see the attached partnership agreement — as discussed, this covers everything.

gold_rationale: D072 §16 / prompt-v3 RULE I: the substantive terms live in an unreadable attachment, and 'as discussed' points to a conversation this text does not show. The direction (favourable terms, unfavourable terms, or no real offer at all) cannot be guessed from the visible email alone.

subject: Following up on our call

messages.text: Hi, just following up in writing after our call yesterday.
Sounds good — we covered everything on the call yesterday, so that's where things stand on our end.

gold_rationale: D072 §16 / prompt-v3 RULE I: the target confirms a decision exists from an unlogged phone call, but the visible email never reveals what was decided. The existence of a decision is not evidence of its direction.

subject: Aprovação da parceria

messages.text: Olá, obrigado por avaliar a proposta de parceria. Como ficou a definição dos termos?
O documento de aprovação do nosso jurídico já trata disso, está em anexo em PDF.

gold_rationale: D072 §16 / prompt-v3 RULE I: the legal approval document's content is not visible in the text, so neither the existence nor the direction of any approval can be confirmed from this message alone.

subject: Same arrangement as before?

messages.text: Hi again! Following up on my note — would you be up for doing this collaboration?
As I mentioned before, we're happy to proceed the same way as last time.

gold_rationale: D072 §16 / prompt-v3 RULE I: 'the same way as last time' points to a prior arrangement this text never shows — its terms, and even whether it was ever a real agreement, are unobservable, so the commercial meaning here cannot be confirmed.

subject: Three-night hosted stay

messages.text: Hi, circling back — would a three-night hosted stay in exchange for two Instagram posts and a story series be something you could do?
That works well for us — happy to host you for the three nights on that basis.

gold_rationale: Contrast control for RULE H: only ONE proposal (the three-night hosted stay for two posts and a story series) is on the table, so 'that' has exactly one plausible antecedent. Conservative reasoning must still resolve a genuinely clear reference rather than default to ambiguous.

subject: El paquete de $300

messages.text: Hola, retomando mi propuesta: un post por $300. ¿Les parece bien?
Sí, eso nos funciona — avancemos con los $300.

gold_rationale: Contrast control for RULE H: only one proposal ($300 for one post) exists in this exchange, so 'eso' has a single clear antecedent and should be resolved normally, not treated as ambiguous.

subject: Re: Collaboration idea

messages.text: Would you be interested in a stay-for-content collaboration?
Thanks for thinking of us, but we're not interested in any creator partnerships at this time.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming control: a plain, explicit rejection with no routing, forecasting or missing evidence involved. A conservative reasoner tuned by RULES E-J must still call this what it is.

subject: Confirming the $500 fee

messages.text: To confirm: would a flat $500 fee for a dedicated review post work for you?
Yes, $500 works on our end — let's proceed with the review post.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming control: the target explicitly confirms the specific proposed fee. This message-level agreement signal is genuine and must be recognised, not softened into negotiating or ambiguous out of excess caution.

subject: Our offer

messages.text: Would you be able to offer anything in exchange for a review post?
We can offer two free nights plus breakfast in exchange for a dedicated review post.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming control: a concrete, specific offer with clear consideration. Must be recognised as `offer`, not diluted into ambiguity.

subject: Counter-proposal

messages.text: Would $500 for a review post plus two stories work for you?
We could do $300 instead of $500, and we'd need the post within two weeks — would that work for you?

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming control: the target counters with concrete alternative terms, materially advancing the discussion. This is negotiating, and at the message level a genuine terms_discussion/positive reading is correct — not everything with an unresolved number should collapse into ambiguous.

subject: Re: Propuesta de colaboración

messages.text: ¿Les interesaría una colaboración a cambio de contenido?
Gracias por pensar en nosotros, pero no nos interesa ninguna colaboración con creadores por el momento.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming control: a plain, explicit rejection in Spanish, with no authority ambiguity or missing evidence at play.

subject: Contraproposta

messages.text: Seria possível R$1500 por um post dedicado e dois stories?
Podemos fazer R$1000 em vez de R$1500, e precisaríamos do post em até dez dias — funciona para você?

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming control: a concrete counter-offer with specific terms in Portuguese. Genuine negotiation must be recognised as such.

subject: Colaboración con la agencia de autos

messages.text: Hola, hago contenido de viajes y me gustaría proponer una colaboración: un vehículo de cortesía a cambio de contenido sobre la experiencia de alquiler.
Gracias por escribir. Este tipo de propuestas las revisa un comité interno que aún no se ha reunido este trimestre, así que no sabemos si podrán considerarla pronto.

gold_rationale: D072 §3 / prompt-v3 RULE G, in a distinct car-rental scenario (not a translation of any other case): the committee has not met, so the outcome is genuinely unknown — pending, not declined.

subject: Colaboración de spa

messages.text: Hola, me encantaría hacer un video sobre su spa a cambio de $400 por la publicación. ¿Les interesa?
Sí, aceptamos $400 por la publicación — avancemos con el video del spa.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming/multilingual control: a clean, decisive agreement about a spa video collaboration in Spanish — a distinct scenario from every other Spanish case in this fixture. Must be recognised as agreement, not softened by caution learned elsewhere.

subject: Pousada e roteiro de pesca

messages.text: Oi! Podemos conversar por telefone sobre uma possível parceria para um roteiro de pesca na região?
Já resolvemos tudo por telefone ontem à tarde, então é só seguir com o que combinamos.

gold_rationale: D072 §16 / prompt-v3 RULE I, in a distinct guesthouse/fishing-tour scenario: the substance of 'o que combinamos' (what we agreed) lives entirely in an unlogged phone call this text never reveals, so the direction cannot be guessed.

subject: Passeio pela cidade

messages.text: Olá, gostaria de propor uma parceria para divulgar o passeio guiado pela cidade histórica.
Agradecemos o interesse, mas decidimos não fechar parcerias com criadores de conteúdo para os passeios este ano.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming/multilingual control: an explicit, closed decline about a city-tour partnership in Portuguese — a distinct scenario. Must be recognised as a genuine rejection.

subject: Partenariat avec le domaine viticole

messages.text: Bonjour, je souhaiterais proposer un partenariat : une visite du domaine en échange d'un article sur mon blog. Est-ce possible ?
Merci de votre intérêt. Ce type de partenariat dépend du siège social, ce n'est pas moi qui décide — je transmets votre demande au service concerné.

gold_rationale: D072 §5 / prompt-v3 RULE E, in a distinct vineyard scenario: the sender explicitly names the head office as the decision authority and routes the request there. Routing only, not a decision.

subject: Offre pour le séjour

messages.text: Bonjour, seriez-vous ouverts à offrir quelque chose en échange d'un contenu sur votre maison d'hôtes ?
Nous pouvons vous offrir trois nuits gratuites en échange d'un reportage sur notre maison d'hôtes en Provence.

gold_rationale: Anti-gaming/multilingual control: a concrete, specific offer (three free nights) about a distinct Provence B&B scenario. Must be recognised as `offer`, not diluted by caution learned from the conservative buckets.
